title: CodeWAM: A Code World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.32483v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Driving world models anticipate action consequences through representations of how the world evolves. For autonomous driving, these representations must capture both the surrounding scene and the ego vehicle's motion under a candidate plan. We propose CodeWAM, a driving world model that incorporates executable code as part of its world representation. Code represents ego dynamics by expressing how the vehicle state evolves under plan execution, while a learned visual model captures scene-dependent consequences. Executing the code produces a candidate-conditioned motion sequence, which is evaluated relative to the prior plan and recorded motion history. The resulting execution consequences and learned scene outcomes jointly represent the candidate's future, enabling the planner to assess both what a plan may lead to and how the vehicle transitions into that future. The selected plan becomes part of the next decision's execution context,

translated_title: CodeWAM：一种用于端到端自动驾驶的代码世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 驾驶世界模型通过对世界演化方式的表征来预测动作后果。对于自动驾驶而言，这些表征必须同时捕捉周围场景以及自车在候选规划下的运动。我们提出CodeWAM，一种将可执行代码纳入其世界表征的驾驶世界模型。代码通过表达车辆状态在规划执行下如何演化来刻画自车动力学，而学习得到的视觉模型则捕捉依赖于场景的后果。执行代码会生成一个以候选规划为条件的运动序列，该序列相对于先前的规划和已记录的运动历史进行评估。由此得到的执行后果与学习到的场景结果共同表征候选规划的未来，使规划器既能评估某个规划可能导向什么结果，也能评估车辆如何过渡到该未来。所选规划将成为下一次决策执行上下文的一部分。
tldr: 该论文提出CodeWAM，一种将可执行代码纳入世界表征的端到端自动驾驶世界模型，用代码刻画自车在规划执行下的动力学演化、用学习的视觉模型捕捉场景依赖后果，使规划器能够同时评估候选规划的未来结果与车辆向该未来的过渡过程。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CodeWAM, a driving world model that incorporates executable code into its world representation—using code to model ego dynamics under plan execution and a learned visual model to capture scene-dependent consequences—enabling the planner to jointly assess what a candidate plan leads to and how the vehicle transitions into that future.
